caption: Fig A – Two-level octree: coarse Level-L cells (blue) exist only outside the refined region; Level-L+1 fine cells (yellow) cover the refined area. All cells stored in a single array sorted by (morton_code, level) composite key. Red elements = multi-level registration at boundary.
description: Two-level octree overlaid on mesh. Coarse cells are absent where the mesh is refined. Single sorted array with (morton, level) composite key enables O(log n) binary search.
